_about: Public-domain Richard Montagu (1577-1641), Bishop of Chichester and then of Norwich, the anti-Calvinist controversialist of the 1620s, for the Word Hoard: A Gagg for the New Gospell? No: A New Gagg for an Old Goose (1624), Immediate Addresse unto God Alone (1624), Appello Caesarem (1625), Diatribae upon the First Part of the Late History of Tithes (1621) and The Acts and Monuments of the Church before Christ Incarnate (1642), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
